package intervention

import (
	"fmt"
	"strings"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
)

type Plan struct {
	Action        domain.TeacherAction
	ReasonCode    string
	ReasonSummary string
	OfferBody     string
}

type Policy interface {
	Code() string
	Version() string
	Validate() error
	Evaluate(domain.PersonalTeacher, domain.LearningActivitySignal) Plan
}

type Registry struct {
	fallback string
	policies map[string]Policy
}

func NewRegistry(fallback string, policies ...Policy) (*Registry, error) {
	registry := &Registry{fallback: strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(fallback)), policies: make(map[string]Policy)}
	for _, policy := range policies {
		if policy == nil || strings.TrimSpace(policy.Code()) == "" || len(strings.TrimSpace(policy.Code())) > 48 ||
			strings.TrimSpace(policy.Version()) == "" || len(strings.TrimSpace(policy.Version())) > 64 || policy.Validate() != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid intervention policy")
		}
		code := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(policy.Code()))
		if _, exists := registry.policies[code]; exists {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("duplicate intervention policy %s", code)
		}
		registry.policies[code] = policy
	}
	if registry.policies[registry.fallback] == nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("intervention fallback policy is not registered")
	}
	return registry, nil
}

func (registry *Registry) Resolve(code string) Policy {
	if registry == nil {
		return nil
	}
	if policy := registry.policies[strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(code))]; policy != nil {
		return policy
	}
	return registry.policies[registry.fallback]
}

type ThresholdPolicy struct {
	Mode                  string
	MinimumFailures       int
	MinimumActiveSeconds  int
	OfferAfterIdleSeconds int
}

func (policy ThresholdPolicy) Code() string    { return policy.Mode }
func (policy ThresholdPolicy) Version() string { return domain.InterventionPolicyVersion }

func (policy ThresholdPolicy) Validate() error {
	if strings.TrimSpace(policy.Mode) == "" || policy.MinimumFailures < 1 || policy.MinimumFailures > 1000 ||
		policy.MinimumActiveSeconds < 1 || policy.MinimumActiveSeconds > 86400 ||
		policy.OfferAfterIdleSeconds < 0 || policy.OfferAfterIdleSeconds > 86400 {
		return fmt.Errorf("invalid threshold intervention policy")
	}
	return nil
}

func (policy ThresholdPolicy) Evaluate(teacher domain.PersonalTeacher, signal domain.LearningActivitySignal) Plan {
	if signal.Progressing || signal.SignalType == "progressing" {
		return silent("evidence_of_progress", "Recent tests show progress, so the teacher stays silent.")
	}
	if signal.SignalType == "student_idle" {
		if policy.OfferAfterIdleSeconds <= 0 || signal.IdleSeconds < policy.OfferAfterIdleSeconds {
			return silent("idle_without_stuck_evidence", "Idle time alone is insufficient for an intervention.")
		}
		return offer(teacher.Language, "extended_idle", "A long idle interval crossed the configured proactive threshold.")
	}
	if signal.SameErrorCount >= policy.MinimumFailures && signal.ConsecutiveFailures >= policy.MinimumFailures &&
		signal.ActiveSeconds >= policy.MinimumActiveSeconds {
		return offer(teacher.Language, "repeated_failure_loop", "Repeated identical failures persisted beyond the configured active-learning threshold.")
	}
	return silent("insufficient_stuck_evidence", "The bounded activity signal does not cross the configured intervention threshold.")
}

func silent(code, summary string) Plan {
	return Plan{Action: domain.TeacherActionStaySilent, ReasonCode: code, ReasonSummary: summary}
}

func offer(language, code, summary string) Plan {
	body := "Похоже, ты зациклился в одном месте. Хочешь небольшую подсказку?"
	if strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(language)), "en") {
		body = "It looks like you may be stuck in the same place. Would you like a small hint?"
	}
	return Plan{Action: domain.TeacherActionIntervene, ReasonCode: code, ReasonSummary: summary, OfferBody: body}
}
